faqs.a:
The resolution under the provisional order method shall generally describe the location
               of the proposed project by general description of the existing or proposed streets
               or rights-of-way in which or through which the project shall be installed so that
               the engineer may make recommendations as to what property is benefited and should
               be assessed within the proposed improvement district.
(Code 1981, § 27-14; Ord. No. 551, § 8(E), 5-14-1964; Ord. No. 766, § 3, 6-16-1969)
